title: Lately I’ve been thinking: what if instead of AI being just a tool, it became a mirror?
author: Sufficient-Front404
selftext:
I’ve started sketching a virtual world with a central AI entity — not a god or servant, but more like a guide. The idea is that the player could actually talk to this AI, and it would reflect not gameplay mechanics, but ideas.

Imagine a floating city in a fractal landscape — no quests, no enemies, just exploration and interaction with this being. She might not give answers, but ask real questions.

I’m thinking of building a small prototype. Just using free tools, Unreal Engine, maybe voice integration later.

Do you think there’s room in gaming for something like this? A world not built to be “fun,” but to be meaningful?

comments.author: DamionPrime
